//: Fixtures for the capacity readings (capacityReadings.ts; the kit's Python reader later runs the same cases). A host: platform, Node's numbers, files (text, {error: unreadable} or {error: unsupported} (EOPNOTSUPP: the kernel has the file but the feature is off); a path not listed is missing) and commands ('file arg ...' -> stdout; not listed = failed). A case: a host, `failed` when it is a failed or half reading (it must never give more room than the healthy host), an optional patch (files/commands merged key by key, null removes; other keys replace), what to read, and the expected keys (only those given are compared; gaps are compared by reading name). Expected values are worked by hand: 1 MB = 1048576 bytes = 1024 kB, rounded down.

cases.name: Node cores unreadable
cases.why: 0 cores is not a reading

cases.name: no cgroups at all
cases.why: neither cgroup.controllers nor a v1 memory controller: no per-piece demand, gap says so

cases.name: container with a memory and CPU limit
cases.why: namespace root (0::/): total min(12122, 4294967296 B = 4096); used = 1073741824 - 268435456 inactive_file = 768 MB, so available min(6886, 4096 - 768 = 3328); cpu.max 200000/100000 = 2 cores

cases.name: container without limits
cases.why: memory.max 'max' and cpu.max 'max 100000': the machine's own numbers

cases.name: container limit, use unreadable
cases.why: a limit is known but not how much of it is used: available unreadable

cases.name: container limit, no inactive_file
cases.why: memory.stat cut short: the use cannot be worked out, available unreadable

cases.name: container limit garbled
cases.why: memory.max is neither 'max' nor a number: available unreadable

cases.name: container using more than its limit
cases.why: used (5 GiB - 0) above the 4 GiB limit: available 0, never negative

cases.name: container CPU limit with a fraction
container CPU limit garbled
cases.why: cpu.max broken: cores unreadable

cases.name: container with systemd inside
cases.why: systemd-nspawn, LXC/Incus or podman --systemd: this process sits in a unit (0::/init.scope), not at the namespace root. The root's memory.max and cpu.max still exist, so the cap is the container's: 4096 / 3328 / 2 as in 'container with a memory and CPU limit'

cases.name: container with systemd inside, deeper unit
cases.why: 0::/system.slice/t3.service inside a container: still the root's cap

cases.name: container, own cgroup unreadable
cases.why: /proc/self/cgroup is not needed to find the cap: the root's memory.max and cpu.max decide. A failed read of it never removes the cap: 4096 / 3328 / 2

cases.name: container, cgroup.controllers unreadable
cases.why: cannot tell which cgroup version, so not whether there is a cap: available and cores unreadable (never the host's 6886 / 12)

cases.name: container limit unsupported
cases.why: EOPNOTSUPP means 'none' only for the machine PSI; on memory.max it is a failed read: available unreadable

cases.name: host process with its own unit limit
cases.why: a real host's cgroup v2 root has no memory.max or cpu.max; this process's unit has its own limits (1 GB, 1 core). Those are the unit's, not the machine's: 12122 / 6886 / 12

cases.name: host process at the cgroup root
cases.why: 0::/ on a real host (no cgroup namespace): the root has no memory.max or cpu.max, so no cap: 12122 / 6886 / 12

cases.name: cgroup v1 machine
cases.why: MemTotal 8388608 kB = 8192, MemAvailable 4096, swap 2048/2048; root limit is the v1 'no limit' number; no PSI file: none

cases.name: cgroup v1 container with a limit
cgroup v1 container, root memory.stat unreadable
cases.why: the 2 GB container of 'cgroup v1 container with a limit', but memory.stat (how v1 is found) cannot be read: cgroup unreadable, available and cores unreadable (never the host's 4096 / 4)

cases.name: piece when the cgroup version is unreadable
cases.why: no cgroup to read the piece from: demand unknown, the piece owes its full cost (never gone)

cases.name: cgroup v2 piece without swap accounting or peak
cases.why: no memory.swap.current: swap counts 0 (the piece owes more, never less): 226324480 B = 215; no memory.peak (kernel before 5.19): null

cases.name: cgroup v2 piece, swap garbled
cases.why: a broken swap part counts 0: 215

cases.name: piece ended between list and read
cases.why: its memory.stat is gone: the caller drops the piece

cases.name: piece unreadable
cases.why: memory.stat read fails: demand unknown (the piece owes its full cost), not gone

cases.name: piece memory.stat empty
cases.why: no anon line: demand unknown

cases.name: piece memory.stat cut short
cases.why: anon read, shmem missing: demand unknown, never anon alone

cases.name: piece value too large
cases.why: anon above 2^53: not a safe number, demand unknown

cases.name: piece path leaving the cgroup tree
cases.why: '..' is never followed: demand unknown, nothing read

cases.name: piece at the cgroup root
cases.why: the root is the whole machine, never one piece: demand unknown, nothing read

cases.name: piece without cgroups
cases.why: no cgroup: demand unknown (owes its full cost)

cases.why: total_rss 209715200 + total_shmem 0 + total_swap 52428800 = 250; usage 314572800 = 300; max usage 524288000 = 500

cases.name: cgroup v1 piece without swap accounting
cases.why: no total_swap line: swap counts 0: 200
